name: acceptance-v1
description: Bo tieu chi nghiem thu chinh thuc cho PPE Viewer GPU (G0 - G4)

P01.name: Compositor resident frame work
P01.description: Compositor khi tai nguyen da resident tren GPU dat chuan 60Hz

P02.name: Camera input latency
P02.description: Native input toi present tren man hinh khi tai nguyen resident

P03.name: New visual in uncached region
P03.description: Tao anh moi o scale/vung chua cache voi scene/resource warm

P04.name: Final image settle after zoom stops
P04.description: Do net toi da toan vung nhin sau khi dung thao tac zoom

P05.name: Continuous sharpening during gesture
P05.description: Khong co khoang trong >150ms ma vung thieu chat luong khong duoc cap nhat pixel huu ich

P06.name: Quality during gesture
P06.description: It nhat 95% dien tich trang co density >= 0.8 trong thao tac va >= 0.98 khi ket thuc

P07.name: Pipeline continuity & integrity
P07.description: 0 blank frame, 0 seam trang, 0 commit sai document/revision, 0 doi engine/mau giua wheel

P08.name: Cold open / page jump overhead
P08.description: Khong cham hon baseline doi chung qua 10%; khong cho compile ca tai lieu

P09.name: Logging overhead
P09.description: Logging nhe bat/tat lech trung vi va p95 <= 3%
